notes: 3968 input + 128 output; 8 measured requests/cohort; text/image; clients 1, 2, 4, 8; mixed NVFP4/FP8 on one RTX 5090 32GB.
New native line: median of three cohort statistics; band: observed min–max, not a confidence interval. VRAM line: maximum across trials.
Three native trials share one worker. Older native and ordinary vLLM/SGLang references have one retained trial each.
Native physical batch 1 queues clients; references allow up to 8 running requests. Native Windows; reference WSL.
All 372 new native request IDs match retained T32 controls. Reference text variants remain; cross-engine long-output equivalence is unproven.
VRAM includes background usage. Maximum observed native sampling gap: 4.284 s; raw samples retained.
Strongest repeated tuned/MTP references and matched INT4/4B comparisons remain pending. Overall 2x target is not established.
